name: Reptile Recall
summary: Reptile Recall brings three games together in one updated, cheeky package. The memory game has been rebuilt so you’re shown iguanas inside their houses, the doors close, and you must remember who’s behind each one to clear the level. Reptile Studio has also been reinvented with new dials that let you control iguana samples, add drumbeats, bass, chords and even farts, then record your track and save it to Data Block A or B to play back whenever you like. Cricket Hunt lets you choose 20, 50 or 100 crickets to search for on the map while Iggy eats them as he goes, but be careful — crickets give him gas and he’ll need to release it. Three different styles of gameplay in one colourful, silly and fun reptile world
